document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You and Norman again dare the swift stream that obstructs 
entry into the hidden valley. You are no sooner through when 
you become aware of a strange tropical scent to the air. The 
conifer  forest  of  the  outer  world  is  gone.  This  landscape 
resembles something from the early Cenozoic.

You remember wild tales you have heard—of a lost Canadian 
valley  warmed  by  Chinook  winds  and  hot  springs,  a  valley 
where prehistoric animals still exist. Could this be it?
Record the keyword INCHCAPE. Go to 63.
